validation_scope_distinction.structural_validation_scope: Evaluated in Gate 04 (06_cog_structural_validation.json): dimensions (318x324), CRS (EPSG:4326), data types (float32), nodata (-9999.0), LZW compression, pyramid overviews, and 256x256 block tiling across all 19 COGs and all 10 bands.
validation_scope_distinction.semantic_validation_scope: Evaluated in Gate 04B/C (07_cog_semantic_validation.json): Band 9 (HOTSPOT_FREQUENCY in [0, 1]) and Band 10 (IS_PERSISTENT_HOTSPOT) recurrence semantics, canonical threshold boundaries (0.0, 0.25, 0.50), persistence agreement, and rescued flags.
validation_scope_distinction.unvalidated_bands_disposition: Bands 1-4 (LST_C, NDVI, NDBI, NDWI) and Bands 5-8 (LST_OBS_COUNT, LST_QA_MEDIAN_K, QUALITY_FLAG, ELIGIBILITY) represent physical/quality raster inputs whose mathematical and quality transformations are verified in Gate 02, Gate 02B, Gate 05, and Gate 06; they are not independently semantic-re-evaluated inside this gate.
